$comment: Linear's DateTime serializes ISO-8601 and has appeared with an offset. The point of this fixture is that the poller must not depend on the source always emitting Z.

cases.why: e1's string sorts LAST lexically, so a since=<string> poll answers 'nothing new' while two later events exist. Silent skip.
e3's string sorts FIRST lexically, so the same poll replays the whole window. Duplicate work, not a skip.
The instant-backed cursor gives the right answer for the same starting point as case 1, which is the whole test: same cursor, two behaviours.
